2188: Clare is the series' protagonist. In the beginning of the series she is number 47 of the organization's 78th generation, making her the lowest ranked claymore. She also holds the distinction of becoming the first individual to willingly become a claymore.
2208: Living in his peaceful village like any ordinary boy, Raki's life is changed forever when most of his family is killed by a Yoma.
2209: One of the Organization's mysterious servants, he is Clare's contact, giving her the new missions received from the organization and collecting the reward money after each mission.
2398: Teresa is known for effortlessly slaying enemies with a faint smile on her face, is the strongest of her generation and considered to be the most powerful Claymore of all time.
2622: Riful is the Abyssal One of the western territory. She was the number one in the first generation of female Claymores and the youngest ever to awaken. She presents herself as cheerful and polite, though she will instantly discard anyone who gets in the way of her goals.
2623: Claymore number three (before Priscilla number two) of the 77th generation, she is known as "Quick Sword Irene", capable of lashing out innumerable lightning fast sword strikes by accumulating all her Youki energy in her sword arm.
2624: After losing her family to a Yoma attack, Priscilla decided to fight all she considered evil in the world.
2702: Miria is Claymore No. 6 of the 78th generation. Her great speed leaves after-images of herself in battle, confusing the opponent, thus earning herself the nickname, "Phantom Miria." She is also skilled at teamwork and tactics.
2731: Deneve is a defensive type Claymore, and thus sports powerful regenerative abilities. She has a rather calm and empathetic personality, and is quite different from her friend Helen. She was part of the awakened-hunting squad led by Miria, along with Helen and Clare.
2732: Number 22 in Clare's generation, Helen's specialty is attacking her enemies with her stretching arms, giving her a surprisingly long range of attack, as well as the ability to constrict the enemy.
2770: One of the Organization's members, he is the contact for Miria and Galatea.
2771: Claymore number three of the seventyeight generation, Galatea acts as the organization's eye because of her superb Youki sensing ability. Galatea can sense not only the size of the Youki of her targets, but also their emotions and actions, from a long distance.
2939: The infamous number four of the seventyeight class, Ophelia harbours an incredible bloodlust, and particularly enjoys killing awakened ones.
3019: Number two of the seventysixth generation, Rafaela and her older sister were the subjects of one of the organizations experiments. The experiment ended in a horrible failure, in which Rafaela lost her eye, and she left the organization as an inactive Claymore.
3197: An offensive fighter holding the rank of number nine in the seventy eight generation. Her trademark ability is twisting her arm, then releasing the energy into one powerful thrust. Honorable and serious, she is well respected and said to be one of the most powerful Claymores.
3332: Ranked number eight in the seventy eight generation, Flora Gained the nickname "Windcutter Flora" because of her lightning fast draw. The windcutter technique allows Flora to draw her sword and slash her opponent in the blink of a second, and cuts the air itself.
3333: Claymore number 14 of generation 78. She is a defensive type.
3334: No. 31 of the 141st generation. Tabitha is a very quiet and serious person. She is very loyal to Miria. She also seems to be very intelligent, helping to strategize and organize her team during battle. Her great Yoki perception gained her the title "The Dark Silver Eye.
3337: Dauf was originally his generation's Claymore #3, surpassed only by Rigaldo and Isley. He is currently Riful's follower and lover, helping her torture captured Claymores and forcing them to Awaken.
3338: Once ranked second in the first generation, Rigardo was Isley's rival, and challenged him after their awakening. Upon his defeat, Rigardo swore his loyalty to Isley. Nicknamed the "Silver-Eyed Lion King", his awakened form is that of an enormous humanoid lion.
3339: Isley is a male Awakened being, ex Number 1 of the Organizations very first generation of warriors. When in his transformed state he resembles a sleek, black centaur whose right arm can act as a lance or axe and the left as a bow or shield.
3341: The highest ranking member of the Organization so far, possibly the leader.
3619: The muscular and aggressive no. 11, Undine uses two swords and had used Youki energy to enhance her muscles.
3835: In charge of Teresa. He is named after the Musée d'Orsay
3960: Noel was well-known for her agility and was known as Stormwind Noel in the organization. She constantly vied with Sophia for the rank #3 position. She was outspoken and tomboyish.
10127: Because of her brute strength, Sophia was called Muscular Sophia in the organization. She had a very polite, lady-like way of speaking except when she was arguing with her rival and friend, Noel. Sophia was among Claymores ranked #2 - #5 sent to kill Teresa.
10146: Elena entered the organization at the same time as Clare and was her closest friend during training. However, while she started her missions later than Clare, she overused her Yoma energy, resulting in her gradually losing control.
10149: Hilda was formerly number 6 of the Organization. She was active at the same time as Miria and they were close friends. When she reached her limit, she gave her black card to Ophelia asking her to pass it on to Miria.
10150: Veronica is a defensive fighter and seems calm and professional. She was one of the division captains in the Northern campaign, who led Cynthia (#14), Helen (#22), Pamela (#35), and Matilda (#41). Veronica was the first warrior killed by Rigardo.
10152: Kathia was part of Jean's team in a hunt for an Awakened Being in the Zakol Mountains. After being captured by Riful and Dauf, she was tortured until she awakened. After concluding that she was too weak, Riful ordered Dauf to kill her.
10154: Eva and her team members (Kate, Lucia, and an unknown member) were killed when they encountered a large number of awakened ones in the North. This led to the Northern Campaign.
19523: Galk is one of the captains of the holy city Rabona and is very close to fellow warrior Sid. He is the older and wiser of the two. Galk's weapon is a longsword, which he uses very effectively. He meets Clare in an earlier episode and helps to purge the city of yoma.
22371: Claudia was Claymore #36 of Clare's time. She was one of the 24 Claymores in the Northern Campaign and was part of Undine's team, along with Deneve (#15), Zelda (#24) and Juliana (#43).
31826: Sid is one of the warriors of the holy city, he along with Galk fights Clare on the roof top while on patrol. He appears brash, arrogant and short tempered early on in the story.
35614: Raki's brother who appears in the first episode.
78341: Zelda/Zeruda is Claymore No. 24 of Clare's generation. She is part of Undine's team in the Northern Campaign, along with Deneve (No. 15), Claudia (No. 36) and Juliana (No. 43).
